---
title: "Team"
---

The team list lives in `team.csv`. To add or change a person, edit that file in
RStudio and re-render; the tables below update automatically.

```{r}
#| label: load-team
#| echo: false
team <- read.csv("team.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
show_group <- function(g) {
  knitr::kable(
    team[team$group == g, c("name", "role", "institute")],
    col.names = c("Name", "Role", "Institute"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Core team (NIOZ)

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_group("Core team")
```

## Partner institutes

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_group("Partner")
```

## Consortium members

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_group("Consortium")
```

Source: [NIOZ project page](https://www.nioz.nl/en/research/projects/phyvir).
Please check names, titles and affiliations before publishing.
